about_short_description.short_description: Roboost is a logistics management software that uses AI to automate and optimize the home delivery operations for businesses.

product.name: Automated Dispatching
product.description: Automates the grouping of orders and assignment of deliveries to available couriers without manual intervention.

product.name: Real-Time Fleet Tracking
product.description: Provides live tracking of delivery vehicles and couriers to monitor progress throughout the delivery process.

product.name: Delivery Team AI Performance Rating
product.description: Uses AI algorithms to evaluate delivery team members' performance objectively, free from human bias, and rewards high performers.

product.name: Ranking Boards
product.description: Translates delivery agents' performance into points and displays rankings to encourage healthy competition and recognize top performers.

product.name: Real-Time Operation Analysis
product.description: Analyzes delivery operations live to identify performance gaps, monitor KPIs, and compare branch or rider performance for data-driven decisions.

identifier.value: Customer Service Analysis and Loyalty Management

product.name: Customer Service Analysis and Loyalty Management
product.description: Tracks individual customer delivery performance and feedback to improve service quality and convert dissatisfied customers into loyal ones.
